title: Listing Highlight: 76' Riva Bahamas 2018
description: Explore the innovative 2018 Riva 76' Bahamas Yacht, a perfect blend of style and technology, now available for a flexible lease with purchase options.
html:
A Closer Look at the 2018 Riva 76′ Bahamas Yacht

The 2018 Riva 76′ Bahamas Yacht stands as a testament to the seamless blend of innovation and style. Available soon for a 36-month lease with a purchase option at zero percent interest, this vessel offers a unique opportunity for those looking to experience cruising at its finest. With its recent restyling, the Riva 76′ Bahamas introduces updated spaces and enhanced functionality, making it a standout choice for discerning yacht enthusiasts.

The Riva 76′ Bahamas has carved a niche in yachting history with its distinctive design and advanced technology. This model, six years post-launch, continues to capture attention with its modernized features and thoughtful restyling. The yacht’s elegant lines and innovative storage solutions make it a vessel that not only meets but exceeds the expectations of its owners.


Luxurious Interior: Galley and Cabins Overview

Inside, the yacht offers a well-appointed galley equipped with top-of-the-line Miele appliances, including a cooktop, oven, and dishwasher. The master cabin features a king-size bed, large windows, and a 50″ Samsung TV, while the VIP and guest cabins provide comfortable accommodations with ample storage and high-quality finishes. Each cabin is thoughtfully designed to maximize comfort and functionality, ensuring a pleasant experience for all aboard.


State-of-the-Art Electronics and Navigation Systems

The Riva 76′ Bahamas is equipped with advanced electronics and navigation systems, including Furuno autopilot and navigation displays, a Garmin VHF, and a Seakeeper #16 for stabilization. These features ensure smooth and precise handling, offering peace of mind whether navigating calm waters or more challenging conditions. The inclusion of a Flir camera and other high-tech tools further enhances the yacht’s navigational capabilities.


Elegant Exterior: Hull, Deck, and Swim Platform

The yacht’s exterior is both functional and stylish, featuring a white hull and superstructure, custom upholstery, and a hydraulic teak swim platform. The electrohydraulic stern garage hatch and swim ladder add convenience, while the cockpit’s Bimini and custom handrails enhance comfort and safety. The deck layout is designed to provide ample space for relaxation and entertainment, making it an ideal setting for social gatherings.

Powerful Performance: Engine and Mechanical Features

Powered by two MAN V12 engines, each delivering 1800 horsepower, the Riva 76′ Bahamas boasts impressive performance capabilities. With a cruising speed of 32 knots and a top speed of 37 knots, it offers both speed and efficiency. The yacht’s mechanical features, including a gyro stabilizer and electric stern thruster, ensure a smooth and stable ride, while the Seafari watermaker and dual Onan generators provide essential support for extended voyages.

Timeless Design Meets Modern Innovation

The 2018 Riva 76′ Bahamas Yacht is a remarkable vessel that combines timeless design with modern innovation. Its luxurious interior, advanced electronics, and powerful performance make it a compelling choice for those seeking a sophisticated and capable yacht.
